# Special Agent Tam (Tamara Stone, eXp Realty)

> Tamara Stone, known as Special Agent Tam, is a licensed Oregon real estate broker (license #201235217) with eXp Realty. She lives in Mountain Park, focuses on Lake Oswego, Oregon, and serves the Portland Metro area. She helps buyers and sellers with Lake Oswego neighborhoods, lakefront and luxury homes (eXp Luxury certified), relocation and first-time home buying. Phone: (503) 349-5236. Website: specialagenttam.com.

## Lake Oswego neighborhood guides
- [All 25 neighborhoods](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/)
- [Birdshill](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/birdshill/): Big wooded lots above the Willamette.
- [Blue Heron](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/blue-heron/): Canal homes on the west end of the lake.
- [Bryant](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/bryant/): Big trees, the canal and a trail loop.
- [North Shore-Country Club](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/country-club-north-shore/): Classic Lake Oswego along the north shore.
- [Evergreen](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/evergreen/): Walk to downtown and Lakewood Bay.
- [First Addition and Forest Hills](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/first-addition-forest-hills/): Older homes, alleys and walks to downtown.
- [Forest Highlands](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/forest-highlands/): Big lots and trailheads on the north side.
- [Glenmorrie](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/glenmorrie/): Estates, big lots and the river nearby.
- [Hallinan Heights](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/hallinan-heights/): Between the lake and the Willamette.
- [Holly Orchard](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/holly-orchard/): History, condos and quick access to Kruse Way.
- [Lake Forest](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/lake-forest/): Close to Kruse Way, with room to stretch out.
- [Lake Grove](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/lake-grove/): Shops and streets on the west end of the lake.
- [Lakewood](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/lakewood/): Lakefront homes on Lakewood Bay.
- [Mary's Landing](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/marys-landing/): The newest neighborhood, on the Willamette.
- [McVey-South Shore](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/mcvey-south-shore/): Lake Front Road, bungalows and the south shore.
- [Mountain Park](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/mountain-park/): The neighborhood I call home.
- [Oak Creek](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/oak-creek/): Maple-lined streets next to Kruse Way.
- [Old Town](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/old-town/): Where the iron furnace and the Willamette meet.
- [Palisades](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/palisades/): Hills, lake views and the south shore.
- [Rosewood](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/rosewood/): Ranch homes and the Tualatin River.
- [Skylands](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/skylands/): Acreage and views on the south hills.
- [Uplands](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/uplands/): Midcentury homes around Springbrook Park.
- [Waluga](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/waluga/): Ball fields, trails and Lake Grove next door.
- [Westlake](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/westlake/): My favorite park, with easy freeway access.
- [Westridge](https://specialagenttam.com/neighborhoods/westridge/): Hills, big trees and the Tualatin River.

## Key facts
- Oswego Lake is private. Lake access goes with specific addresses, through the Lake Oswego Corporation, for lakefront homes and homes with a lake easement.
- Some homes with a Lake Oswego mailing address sit outside city limits, in unincorporated Clackamas County or in Rivergrove.
